messages:
jordan: Kicking off a slow rollout for inference-runtime v4.9.0 to eu-west — 5% canary now. Deploy id deploy-1995001234. @ops-oncall @samira please watch p95/p99 and 5xx for 20m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-1995001234] Canary started: inference-runtime v4.9.0 -> eu-west (5%). Check rollout dashboard: https://redwood/rollouts/1995001234 :rocket:

samira: seeing p95 for text-gen up ~12% vs baseline over the last 3m. Not huge but noticeable. traces: https://traces/abcd

mike: any uptick in 5xxs?

deploy-bot: ALERT: inference-text-gen eu-west p95 increased 12% over baseline; 5xx rate crossed threshold (0.1% -> 0.25%).

ops-oncall: Confirmed 5xx increase on podset inference-svc-gn-7. spike correlates with requests routed to v4.9.0.

ana: (typo fix)

ana: Sorry — meant ana.

ana: Recommend pause before stepping to 20%. Also suggest enabling full request logs and route pin for critical endpoints. :warning:

jordan: Agreed — pause at 5% and run quick revert plan. @mike can you pause the rollout?

mike: running: ```
rollout-manager pause --id deploy-1995001234
```

deploy-bot: [deploy-1995001234] Rollout paused at 5% by mike. Next step: investigation. To continue: `rollout-manager resume --id deploy-1995001234` (manual approval required).

samira: starting bisect between commits c3f4a2 -> d9e8f1, focusing on the attention-kernel change that landed in v4.9.0.

ana: I'll pin traffic for /v1/generate-payments and /v1/chat-highprio to v4.8.9 now:
```
route-manager set --service inference-gen --routes "/v1/generate-payments,/v1/chat-highprio" --version v4.8.9 --force
```

ops-oncall: Pin applied. Created incident INC-9832 and muted non-critical alerts for 15m.

jordan: Good. We'll keep hold until bisect/rollforward tests pass. Next check-in 20m. If no regression, we can bump to 10% then 20%. :thumbsup:

product-ops: Noted — holding customer comms until we have ETA.

samira: running a reduced-load smoke-run against v4.9.0 in staging now, will post logs when done.

mike: thanks. tagging @deploy-bot to keep timeline.

deploy-bot: [INC-9832] Event logged. Rollout paused; manual approval required to resume. Audit: mike, jordan, ana.
